name: IC — VOL
description: IC cluster containing four parts in the VOL package family using footprints such as VOL_SMD, VOL_SMD2, VOL_X2, and VOL_DUAL.
selection_hints: Select when requiring IC parts with VOL family footprints including VOL_SMD, VOL_SMD2, VOL_X2, or VOL_DUAL.
Verify part suitability given through-hole and unknown mount classifications.
Note that all four parts are currently in quality tier C.
avoid_when: Avoid when the PCB design requires package footprints outside the VOL family.
Do not use if planner-visible components are required, as planner visible count is zero.
Avoid if tier C quality classification is not acceptable for the project.
